Title: Delivery Engineer, ML, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM. The hard problem Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions. What You'll Do Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation. Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers. Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases. Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use. Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis. Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production. Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team. What Success Looks Like Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production. Who You Are The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust. The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric. The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works. The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments. Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries. Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework. Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with our data engineers. Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI. Solid experiment design and uplift measurement. Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America. Nice to have DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Model governance in regulated industries such as banking and telco: model documentation, explainability and PII handling Able to travel to the US when necessary Reporting and location You report to your pod's Lead Delivery Engineer and work alongside our data delivery engineers and product engineering team. The role is based in Americas. Delivery runs remotely, with occasional visits to our largest customers. Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Title: Delivery Engineer, Data, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM. The hard problem The challenge isn't moving rows; it's reasoning consistency. Our AI must produce the same high-quality insights wherever the data lives, from data that is different at every customer. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions. What You'll Do Data discovery: work with the customer's engineers to understand their sources, and help build our Data Discovery Agent, which will analyze data, suggest mappings and scaffold first pipelines. Canonical modeling: map source data into Hilbert's unified growth models, and help shape new models for industries we haven't served yet. Hybrid integration: build and run ETL and ELT pipelines through Hilbert's data orchestration layer, which controls them whether they run on our stack (Dagster, Airbyte, ClickHouse) or natively in the customer's warehouse. AI semantic layer: define the metadata, metrics and business logic in our semantic layer, built on Cube (cube.dev), that let our agents understand custom data without hallucinating. Secure integration: connect Hilbert and the customer's cloud with least-privilege access and private connectivity. Data quality: own monitoring and quality checks until the deployment is production-ready, and keep it healthy. Productization: turn repeated work into product with our product engineering team. Who You Are The translator: you earn the trust of a customer's data architect quickly and turn the logic of their custom tables into something our reasoning engine understands. The data ontologist: you know AI needs more than a table; it needs context, and you have the discipline to define what the data means. The pilot: you're excited to help build AI agents that take on the heavy lifting of discovery and pipeline scaffolding. The systems thinker: you build reusable patterns, tests and automation instead of one-off pipelines, so a small team can deliver across very different environments without cutting corners. The adapter: you're at home in whatever environment a customer brings, from their cloud and warehouse to their security rules, and you find a working solution quickly. Extensive data engineering experience, with expert SQL and data modeling, strong Python, and dbt or Spark. Hands-on with Databricks, Snowflake (including Snowpark) or BigQuery, and ClickHouse, plus an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow. Working knowledge of cloud IAM and networking on AWS, Azure or GCP. Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America. Nice to have ML engineering experience DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Able to travel to the US when necessary Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Title: CRO Lead (Hands-On)
Description: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what Success Looks Like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work Excellent cultural fit as per our values above Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience Accountabilities What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week. CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate Application + Screening Test Project Technical Interview Culture Fit Interview Salary Expectation USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

Title: Delivery Pod Lead, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Signed Deals Into Working Data Foundations Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. For enterprise customers, the data foundation runs either on our managed ClickHouse stack or warehouse-native inside the customer's own Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. The hard problem Every enterprise customer is different, but our AI must reason the same way wherever the data lives. Your team turns messy, unique customer data into a consistent data foundation and ML, fast, and you decide how each delivery gets done. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. What You'll Do Lead and grow a small team of data and ML engineers who will be delivering the data foundation. Review solution designs and proof-of-concept scopes before they reach customers, and decide what can be delivered and how. Own each delivery after signature: staff it with the right engineers, and own its plan, timeline and quality. Stay hands-on in architecture, data discovery, canonical modeling, semantic layers, ETL and ELT orchestration across customer and Hilbert environments, secure cloud integration, and reviews of feature and model work. Help build our Data Discovery Agent, which will analyze customer data, suggest mappings and scaffold first pipelines, and bring it into your team's work as it matures. Be the main technical contact for our customers' engineering teams. Work with product engineering to turn repeated delivery work into product, and bring new industries and stacks to them early. Help our sales engineers learn the delivery side and engineering capabilities. Who You Are The player-coach: you lead engineers and still design, write and review the hard parts yourself. The translator: you earn a customer data architect's trust quickly and turn the logic of their systems into something our reasoning engine understands. The pilot: you're excited to help build AI agents that take on the heavy lifting of discovery and pipeline scaffolding. The systems thinker: you see delivery as a system, not a series of projects. You design the processes, standards, reusable patterns and automation that let a small team handle very different environments without slowing down or cutting corners. Extensive field experience in data engineering, data architecture or ML engineering, ideally from engineering consultancy or B2B delivery of data and ML projects, including leading engineers on customer projects. Hands-on delivery on Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and comfort with modern stacks such as Dagster, Airbyte, ClickHouse and Cube. Working knowledge of cloud security and system integration on AWS, Azure or GCP. Experience working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish, for working with customers across the region. Nice to have Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Regulated industry consultancy experience Able to travel to the US when necessary Reporting and location You report to our Senior Leader for Forward Deployed Engineering. The role is based in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, or Peru with occasional visits to our largest customers in the North and South America. Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The perfect mix between technical experience and customer-facing readiness mindset. You have carried enterprise security and architecture reviews in a regulated industry to a decision, and you know the difference between a question and a blocker. Fluency in deployment and data-boundary concepts, enough to present them and spot what a customer needs changed: VPC and private link, cross-cloud connectivity, compute in place, data sharing, egress cost, data residency, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 requirements. Hands-on SQL, comfort reading Python, being able to implement scripts when necessary. Clear writing and compelling presentation: solution designs, data flows and interfaces an engineer can build from.
